description: Developer machine prepared for internal relative decisions: on mains power, no throttling, clean sources, background load bounded. Adjusted on 8 October 2026 because macOS idle maintenance keeps a resting Mac above the first thresholds: foreign CPU 150 % (was 50 %) excluding the agent app that drives the run, load per CPU 0.35 (was 0.25). Paired blocks keep relative ratios valid; absolute figures stay unpublishable.
